negative_reviews.author: Mukesh Madhavan
negative_reviews.text: The restaurant had a good vibe, the food was not so good, we went for ramen and the chicken was very dry , it was bland with no flavour. My son did not eat it. Service was good. Parking at Eldon Square

negative_reviews.author: Brandon Brown
negative_reviews.text: I orderd a chicken Ramon bowl not spicy. The broth tasted like water and the chicken i was expecting was going to be sliced but no it was fried chicken so with it being sat in the broth made the crispy chicken soggy and horrible I won't be ordering that again but all other stuff we ordered was tasty and nice .

negative_reviews.author: Oleg K
negative_reviews.text: They work till 10 pm but don't let people in at 9:15

negative_reviews.author: April Martinez
negative_reviews.text: FOOD: Steak Tataki - presentation is really great, but the dish is cold, lukewarm at best (uneven temp). I was expecting hot or even atleast around 65C, but I don't know the proper standard temp for this dish. I could feel the grease of the beef in my mouth. Not great. But I don't waste food, so I have to eat it with difficulty hahaha and we came with high expectation so we came in really hungry from Carlisle. Chicken tonkatsu - okay Prawn Tempura - highly recommended Salmon Panko roll - highly recommended Strawberry lemonade - is a hit with and popping pearls, my girls did not like coconut jelly, but for me, I loved it. Watermelon lemonade - okay SERVICE: Great and quick ATMOSPHERE: We came in at lunch time, before they opened at 12, online said its 11:30 on Mondays. So we we re just huddlled by the door looking at menus. No friendly staff although there seem to be one working there, so we decided to walk and come back on the dot as we are only walk in customers, but we were accommodated by the staff. Nice and clean. Loved the geisha art staring down at you. Nice touch. If not for the screaming toddler beside our table I can give this a 3/4 star. So that was the whole dining experience today. I noticed 10% SC as I was paying. Only coz it was mentioned by the staff.
